name: hexer
description: Get the exact color palette of any website, straight from its CSS.

scripts.zip: npm run build && rm -f hexer.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../hexer.zip . && cd .. && echo 'hexer.zip ready'
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp -R manifest.json popup.html popup.css icons src dist/ && rm -f dist/icons/store-icon* && find dist -name '.DS_Store' -delete && echo 'dist/ ready — load this folder unpacked'
